shared_training.sample_schedule_policy: one 10000-event materialized schedule per variant; short run consumes first 500 events; fresh full run consumes all events from index 0
shared_training.one_finding_fallback: 1 positive + 2 negatives; confusion not solved but moving forward

v1_opt.description: low differential LR, warmup, poly schedule, gradient clipping

v12_opt_poscrop.description: v1 plus require every selected positive prompt to be non-empty in the sampled patch

v123_opt_poscrop_emptyloss.description: v12 plus empty-target BCE-only loss and weighted BCE

v1234_opt_poscrop_emptyloss_ds.description: v123 plus external deep-supervision weighting that drops the lowest-resolution output

validation.dataset_selection: fixed evaluator-compatible JSON overrides; do not use --limit for probe definition

known_differences_from_pretraining_or_vo: ReX one-finding fallback uses 1 positive + 2 negatives because paper fallback is unresolved
Runs use 100 optimizer updates per epoch by project standardization
Runs are single GPU true batch1 with no gradient accumulation
Exp003 uses low differential fine-tuning LR based on external successful ReX runs
Variants v12+ enforce every selected positive prompt to be non-empty in the patch
Variants v123+ use empty-target BCE-only downweighted loss and weighted BCE
Variant v1234 drops the lowest-resolution deep-supervision output
